title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
title_zh: Needwise：基于需求级类型化决策的无生成式对话推荐
abstract_en: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). With the graded attributes withheld from the records, so that needs must be inferred from names, descriptions and reviews, Needwise-HF ranks Google Local requests significantly better than GPT-6 Sol (0.383 against 0.343 nDCG@10) and is not significantly different from the strongest LLM ranker on Google Local and Yelp; these comparisons keep their sign under every treatment of unrecorded attributes we test. It costs a fraction of GPT-6 Sol's API price and answers in 2.5 s at the median on Google Local, against 5.6 s for GPT-6 Sol. In conversations, the typed state keeps the ranking across switches and returns, but it recognizes only 19-27% of withdrawn needs.
abstract_zh: 对话推荐系统不仅要处理目录未完整记录的需求，还要跟踪用户新增、撤回或反转需求，以及在不同请求间切换。传统 LLM 排序器每轮都要重读对话，延迟较高，且无法从排序中看出候选满足了哪些需求。Needwise 将对话推荐拆解为类型化决策：对预定义问题输出固定选项的概率，而不生成文本。每轮通过一次结构化请求，将用户消息映射到目录字段，用用户原话保留字段无法表达的需求，并判断本轮如何改变此前的各项需求。排序时，Needwise-HF 优先按品类、地点和价格等硬性需求划分层级，在同一层级内等权结合整体判断与逐项需求判定（支持、不符或未知）。在隐藏用于评测的属性、仅凭名称、描述和评论推断需求的设置下，Needwise-HF 在 Google Local 上显著优于 GPT-6 Sol（nDCG@10 为 0.383 对 0.343），在 Google Local 和 Yelp 上与最强 LLM 排序器均无显著差异。不同的未记录属性处理方式未改变比较方向。Needwise-HF 的 API 成本仅为 GPT-6 Sol 的一小部分，在 Google Local 上的中位响应时间为 2.5 秒，对比 GPT-6 Sol 的 5.6 秒。类型化状态可在用户切换请求后回到原请求时保持排序，但只能识别 19%–27% 的需求撤回。
key_points_zh: 每轮用一次结构化请求更新需求状态：能映射的需求写入目录字段，其余保留用户原话。
Needwise-HF 优先考虑品类、地点和价格等硬性需求，层内等权结合整体判断和逐项需求判定。
隐藏评测属性后，Needwise-HF 在 Google Local 上显著优于 GPT-6 Sol（nDCG@10：0.383 对 0.343），在 Google Local 和 Yelp 上与最强 LLM 排序器均无显著差异。
Google Local 上的中位响应时间从 GPT-6 Sol 的 5.6 秒降至 2.5 秒，API 成本也更低；但需求撤回识别率仅为 19%–27%。

agent-e-commerce.reason: 核心贡献是把自然语言中的品类、地点、预算和软偏好映射为目录约束或逐项证据，并随对话更新候选排序。同一候选池上的双数据集对照、组件比较和缺失属性压力测试支持混合排序，并量化了质量、延迟和成本的权衡。多轮实验仅验证合成对话中的重排，撤回需求的识别率仅为19%–27%。
